name: Massaliasuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Allodaposuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in Eusuchia, the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Massaliasuchus is an allodaposuchid eusuchian from the Fuvelian Lignites of southeastern France.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from an unnamed unit in southeastern France.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Martin and Buffetaut 2008
